Package org.apache.juneau.bct.assertions

Class InlineScriptSafety

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.bct.assertions.InlineScriptSafety
public final class InlineScriptSafety extends Object
Guards shipped resources against a literal closing script tag (</script, matched case-insensitively).

Host pages may inline JavaScript or CSS resources into an HTML <script> block. The HTML parser ends that block at the first closing script tag it sees, even one inside a comment or string, which silently truncates the rest of the resource. Nothing fails loudly, so this check names each offending file and line instead.

Example:

// Fail if any *.js or *.css file beside juneau-views.js contains a closing script tag. InlineScriptSafety.assertNoScriptCloseTag(ViewsMixin.class, "/org/apache/juneau/views/juneau-views.js", ".js", ".css");

  • Method Details

    • assertNoScriptCloseTag

      public static void assertNoScriptCloseTag(Class<?> anchor, String resource, String... extensions) throws IOException
      Asserts that no resource beside the specified anchor resource contains a closing script tag.

      The directory is located through the classpath, so the resources must be on the file system (not in a jar).

      Parameters:
      anchor - Class used to resolve resource.
      resource - Resource path, absolute or relative to anchor's package, of a file in the directory to scan.
      extensions - File-name suffixes to scan (e.g. ".js"). Must not be empty.
      Throws:
      IOException - If the directory cannot be located or a file cannot be read.
      org.opentest4j.AssertionFailedError - If no matching files were found, or any contains a closing script tag.

    • listResources

      public static List<Path> listResources(Class<?> anchor, String resource, String... extensions) throws IOException
      Lists the files in the directory containing the specified resource that end with one of the specified suffixes.
      Parameters:
      anchor - Class used to resolve resource.
      resource - Resource path, absolute or relative to anchor's package, of a file in the directory to scan.
      extensions - File-name suffixes to include.
      Returns:
      The matching files, sorted by path. Never null.
      Throws:
      IOException - If the resource does not exist, is not on the file system, or the directory cannot be listed.

    • findCloseTags

      public static List<String> findCloseTags(String name, String text)
      Finds each line of the specified text containing a closing script tag.
      Parameters:
      name - Name used to identify the text in the results (typically the file name).
      text - The text to scan.
      Returns:
      A name:line entry (1-based) for each offending line. Never null.
